title: Lint job failing in its install step
description: A job named lint fails while pip resolves conflicting versions
rationale: Guard for BENCH-CLASS-007: only the failing step may mark output as quoted source, never the job name. A real dependency failure must stay dependency_failure so policy escalates it.

event.message: ERROR: Cannot install flake8==7.0 and pyflakes==2.0 because these package versions have conflicts.
